title: Rename one of the two top-level CurriculumSummary classes (AG-4 duplicate)
why: Two unrelated top-level classes share the name CurriculumSummary: parent_dashboard_aggregator.dart's version has fields (curriculum, completionPercentage, paceStatus: PaceStatusType, points); cross_curriculum_aggregator.dart's version has different fields (curriculumId, completionPercentage, paceStatus: PaceStatus?, nextDueItem, todayTaskCount, lastCompletionAt). A future unqualified import or IDE auto-import can silently pick the wrong shape, and grepping for 'the CurriculumSummary type' returns two different contracts with overlapping field names.
recommendation: Rename one — e.g. ParentDashboardCurriculumSummary in parent_dashboard_aggregator.dart — to make the two types textually distinct.
acceptance_criteria: An AG-4 uniqueness checker (grep for duplicate `^class <Name>` across lib/) is added to make audit and reports zero duplicates for this pair.
